summary: Comprehensive testing of MamanDouce application - All major pages and features tested successfully. Backend APIs 100% passing (16/16 tests). Frontend pages load correctly with beautiful pastel bombé styling. One critical bug found in api.js (duplicate favorites object).

ui_bugs.issue: api.favorites.getAll is not a function - caused by duplicate 'favorites' object in api.js (lines 101-106 and 267-272). The second definition overwrites the first, breaking food favorites functionality.

integration_issues.issue: Console error: TypeError: api.favorites.getAll is not a function. Food favorites cannot be loaded on FoodLibraryPage.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Rename the second 'favorites' object in /app/frontend/src/utils/api.js (lines 267-272) to 'babyNamesFavorites' to avoid overwriting the food favorites API. The food library uses api.favorites.getAll() but it's being overwritten by the baby names favorites API which only has get(), sync(), merge(), clear() methods.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG: /app/frontend/src/utils/api.js has two 'favorites' objects defined - the second one (for baby names, lines 267-272) overwrites the first one (for food favorites, lines 101-106). This breaks the FoodLibraryPage.js which calls api.favorites.getAll().
The baby names favorites API should be renamed to 'babyNamesFavorites' or similar to avoid the naming conflict.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all pages load, one API integration bug)

seed_data_creation: None required - existing admin account used
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major pages tested and working: Home, Profile, Settings, Postpartum (with all sub-sections), Baby Names, Food Library, Cycle Tracking, Calculator. The pastel bombé styling is consistent throughout. Accordions in Breastfeeding section work correctly. One critical bug: api.favorites.getAll() is broken due to duplicate object definition in api.js.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In /app/frontend/src/utils/api.js, there are two 'favorites' objects defined. The first one (lines 101-106) has methods: add, getAll, remove, check. The second one (lines 267-272) has methods: get, sync, merge, clear. JavaScript object property assignment overwrites the first definition with the second, so api.favorites.getAll becomes undefined.
reproduction_steps: 4. See error: TypeError: api.favorites.getAll is not a function
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Rename the second favorites object (for baby names) to 'babyNamesFavorites' and update BabyNamesPage.js to use the new name.
